sentences.text: Arctacanthus is a genus within the class Chondrichthyes, which includes cartilaginous fish, and belongs to the parent group Hybodontiformes.
The animal is known only from isolated hook-shaped ichthyoliths believed to be dermal denticles of a chimaeran.
The genus Arctacanthus was described by Nielsen in 1932.
Dolophonodus is a synonym of the genus Arctacanthus.
Arctacanthus lived during the Permian and possibly the Triassic periods.

Some researchers have attributed the ichthyoliths of Arctacanthus to teeth or hybodont cephalic spines. It is uncertain whether similar ichthyoliths found in Japan and China belong to the genus Arctacanthus due to differences in age, location, and size.
